h1: Four openings; one rule: verify paid demand.
room_line: MUNAFIK: MELAWAN IBLIS has the strongest recognizable package; BABY UDON has the clearest promotion-assisted test; BAPAKMU KIPER and AUTOPSY DEAD BODY CAN TALK remain discovery questions.
coming_kick: All four Indonesian releases are locally eligible for the 3 September slate; only BABY UDON appeared on the captured SAMS public Coming surface.
coming_caveat: Public absence is not private booking or DCP truth. Programming owns the opening posture; this Map supplies questions and falsifiable priors, not show advice.
signal_note: Do not compare raw social totals across titles: the samples and denominators are not equivalent.

eligibility.basis: Indonesian principal cast, director, writer, producer and Indonesian village setting establish local-release relevance; the title is absent from the supplied SAMS public Coming capture.

coming.meta: Arya Saloka, Acha Septriasa, Unlimited Production and Skop Productions: Indonesian Munafik adaptation with Dimas Aditya, Donny Damara and Nova Eliza.
coming.logline: Grief-stricken ruqyah practitioner Adam returns to confront the supernatural force tormenting Fitri and uncovers the dark secret behind her possession.
coming.quality: Emotion-led religious horror: early coverage highlights grief, spiritual conflict and Arya Saloka's Quranic delivery, but no robust independent current-film verdict is readable.
coming.gold: Floor-worthy, not expansion-worthy: a familiar regional IP, bankable local cast and accessible religious-horror premise support discovery, while ticket demand remains unproven.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign: poster activation, press screening, conference coverage and Makassar event posts show sustained promotion, not proven ticket conversion.
coming.social: Visible but fandom-skewed social activity: ten captured TikToks concentrate on Arya Saloka, gala moments and Makassar promotion, with limited comment depth.
coming.demand: Purchase demand remains unverified: release readiness and directional social reach are visible, but no trustworthy presale volume, seat occupancy or paid-admission evidence was captured.
coming.risk: Main downside is false confidence from promotion and actor fandom: measurable ticket intent is absent, independent quality evidence is thin and schedule aggregators conflict.
coming.bet: Top-half Day-1 admissions per show among new releases, retaining at least 70% of normalized Day-1 occupancy by Day 4.
coming.nug: Grief, faith and Arya Saloka’s noted Quranic delivery give this familiar possession premise a distinct emotional hook.

lanes.read: Grief-stricken ruqyah practitioner Adam returns to confront the supernatural force tormenting Fitri and uncovers a dark secret behind her possession.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured synopsis consistently identifies Adam, his withdrawal after his wife's death, Fitri's possession and the concealed cause of her terror.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as religious horror with an emotional recovery arc, not merely a possession film.

lanes.read: Recognizable local leads and a regional horror IP: Arya Saloka and Acha Septriasa lead an Unlimited Production and Skop Productions collaboration.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fetched reporting names Arya Saloka, Acha Septriasa, Dimas Aditya, Donny Damara and Nova Eliza, with Unlimited Production and Skop Productions leading production.
lanes.decision_consequence: Talent and IP recognition justify visibility and a discovery floor, but not an automatic allocation premium.

lanes.read: Emotion-led religious horror: early coverage highlights grief, spiritual conflict and Arya Saloka's Quranic delivery, but no robust independent current-film verdict is readable.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Teknogav observed that Arya Saloka's Quranic recitation drew attention and described trauma and acceptance as substantial dramatic layers.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use independent review or paying-audience response to test whether the package delivers on its promise.

lanes.read: Floor-worthy, not expansion-worthy: a familiar regional IP, bankable local cast and accessible religious-horror premise support discovery, while ticket demand remains unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The Indonesian adaptation combines Arya Saloka and Acha Septriasa with the established Munafik concept and a confirmed 3 September national release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title visible and apply the Day-0 discovery floor; require actual sales or occupancy before adding shows.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign: poster activation, press screening, conference coverage and Makassar event posts show sustained promotion, not proven ticket conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A poster launch occurred at TangCity Mall on 17 July, followed by an Epicentrum press screening and conference on 24 August and Makassar-focused social activity.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect baseline awareness around opening, but do not translate campaign volume into extra screens without purchase evidence.

lanes.read: Visible but fandom-skewed social activity: ten captured TikToks concentrate on Arya Saloka, gala moments and Makassar promotion, with limited comment depth.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-post sample peaked at 11,733 views and 679 likes; another post produced 22 comments and 23 shares, but most posts had zero comments.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat social as cast-led awareness; compare it with film-specific engagement and paid attendance.

lanes.read: Purchase demand remains unverified: release readiness and directional social reach are visible, but no trustworthy presale volume, seat occupancy or paid-admission evidence was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A third-party schedule page displayed showtimes and prices, but its conflicting dates make it unsuitable as evidence of genuine availability or sell-through.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified presale transactions, sold-seat counts or opening-day paid admissions by relevant site.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not allocate above the discovery floor; let verified Day-1 occupancy and admissions trigger any expansion.

lanes.read: Main downside is false confidence from promotion and actor fandom: measurable ticket intent is absent, independent quality evidence is thin and schedule aggregators conflict.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Most captured TikToks generated few or no comments, while the readable schedule page mixed 3 September, 13 August and a 2025 date.
lanes.decision_consequence: Separate promotion and fandom from paid attendance before increasing confidence.

ai_rating.actionability: High after opening: Day-1 admissions per show and normalized Day-4 retention can confirm or falsify the thesis.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: a conflicting schedule page shows prices, but verified presales, sold seats and paid admissions are missing.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Moderate: a multi-stage campaign and ten TikToks show actor-led awareness; most posts drew no comments.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Medium-high: promotion and fandom may overstate demand while quality consensus and ticket intent remain unverified.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Relevant: a 3 September domestic release; absence from SAMS public Coming does not resolve booking or DCP status.
ai_rating.source_confidence: High: premise, cast, release and campaign are corroborated; independent current-film verdicts remain thin.

coming.meta: Caitlin Halderman, Denny Sumargo, Sumargo Films and LYTO Pictures: directed by Fajar Bustomi from Oka Aurora’s screenplay.
coming.logline: An Indonesian woman and her Japanese husband face infertility, family pressure and terminal cancer in a romance inspired by Fanny and Hajime Kondoh’s true story.
coming.quality: Emotionally effective but thinly independently tested: one full review praises natural dialogue, controlled messaging and Caitlin Halderman’s emotional range, while broad ratings remain absent.
coming.gold: Clear emotional proposition, uncertain conversion: a viral true story, recognizable leads and grief-to-hope positioning make the film easy to explain, but none proves paid demand.
coming.promo: Substantial launch support, not organic demand: the campaign used multi-city premieres and meet-and-greets, a Jakarta gala and Day-1 BOGOF, although the offer platform is disputed.
coming.social: Directional interest with heavy query contamination: one film-positive TikTok reached 27,576 views, but the largest sampled posts concerned adjacent personalities and Instagram results were unrelated food content.
coming.demand: Purchase intent remains unproven: public opening-day schedules and Day-1 BOGOF reduce buying friction, but the bundle contains no presale volume, seat-fill evidence or sold-out sessions.
coming.risk: Promotion can overstate the opening: premiere emotion, producer testimony, contaminated social reach and BOGOF may create apparent momentum that does not survive full-price audience behavior.
coming.bet: The true-story emotion and Day-1 BOGOF will drive sampling, but paid occupancy will weaken by Day 4.
coming.nug: One favorable review supports the film’s emotional delivery, but its roadshow, personality-led social reach and Day-1 BOGOF can overstate audience momentum.

lanes.read: An Indonesian woman and her Japanese husband face infertility, family pressure and terminal cancer in a romance inspired by Fanny and Hajime Kondoh’s true story.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured synopsis consistently identifies Fanny and Hajime Kondoh, their struggle to have a child and Hajime’s cancer diagnosis.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as an accessible true-story relationship drama, with grief and family resilience as the primary audience promise.

lanes.read: Caitlin Halderman and Denny Sumargo lead for Sumargo Films and LYTO Pictures, directed by Fajar Bustomi from Oka Aurora’s screenplay.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable credits independently agree on both leads, the director, writer and production houses.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognizable leads and Fajar Bustomi provide a credible commercial identity, but producer-owned talent should not be mistaken for audience demand.

lanes.read: Emotionally effective but thinly independently tested: one full review praises natural dialogue, controlled messaging and Caitlin Halderman’s emotional range, while broad ratings remain absent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Liputan6’s readable review specifically praises the progression from humor to deeper emotion, natural performances and Caitlin Halderman’s portrayal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the favorable review as one signal; let Day-1 and Day-4 paying-audience behavior test it.

lanes.read: Clear emotional proposition, uncertain conversion: a viral true story, recognizable leads and grief-to-hope positioning make the film easy to explain, but none proves paid demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The source story originated in Fanny Kondoh’s public account and has been packaged around love, family, loss and perseverance with Denny Sumargo and Caitlin Halderman leading.
lanes.decision_consequence: Give the title enough Day-0 access to discover family and female-skewing emotional demand, but do not expand from story familiarity alone.

lanes.read: Substantial launch support, not organic demand: the campaign used multi-city premieres and meet-and-greets, a Jakarta gala and Day-1 BOGOF, although the offer platform is disputed.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable reports document seven pre-Jakarta gala cities, further tour stops and a Day-1 BOGOF offer.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect launch sampling to be promotion-assisted; separate BOGOF admissions from normal paid demand before judging the hold.

lanes.read: Directional interest with heavy query contamination: one film-positive TikTok reached 27,576 views, but the largest sampled posts concerned adjacent personalities and Instagram results were unrelated food content.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured TikTok sample contains film reactions and emotional responses, while high-reach adjacent-personality posts and wholly irrelevant Instagram food results weaken title-level interpretation.
lanes.decision_consequence: Separate film-specific engagement from personality and food-query contamination.

lanes.read: Purchase intent remains unproven: public opening-day schedules and Day-1 BOGOF reduce buying friction, but the bundle contains no presale volume, seat-fill evidence or sold-out sessions.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Specific Jakarta sessions are publicly listed for 3 September and a Day-1 BOGOF offer is reported, placing the title near purchase without measuring actual conversion.
lanes.missing_fact: Site-level advance sales, paid admissions, seat occupancy and BOGOF redemption share are missing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the Day-0 discovery floor, but make any expansion contingent on paid Day-1 occupancy and discount-adjusted conversion rather than campaign reach.

lanes.read: Promotion can overstate the opening: premiere emotion, producer testimony, contaminated social reach and BOGOF may create apparent momentum that does not survive full-price audience behavior.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The strongest positive signals combine one favorable review with campaign events and discounted sampling; no broad independent ratings or verified purchase conversion are captured.
lanes.decision_consequence: Track full-price paid behavior separately from BOGOF-assisted sampling.

ai_rating.actionability: High: paid occupancy and BOGOF mix can distinguish promotional sampling from durable demand.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: opening-day sessions are public, but presales, seat fill and paid admissions are missing.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Medium: strong roadshow and BOGOF support; social interest is materially contaminated.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: discounted sampling and campaign emotion may not survive full-price audience behavior.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: High: eligible Indonesian theatrical release, also listed on the SAMS public Coming surface.
ai_rating.source_confidence: High: credits, premise, campaign and BOGOF are corroborated; quality rests on one full review.

coming.meta: Fedi Nuril and PT Entelekey Sinema Indonesia: Ali Fikry and Tanta Ginting support; directed by Ody C. Harahap. This is Entelekey Sinema Indonesia’s first production.
coming.logline: A gifted young striker’s professional hopes force his estranged father, a former tarkam goalkeeper, to rebuild a veteran village team and try to regain his son’s trust.
coming.quality: Warm crowd response, not a quality verdict: a Lombok gala report observed laughter and tears, but no readable independent review or representative audience assessment was captured.
coming.gold: Accessible local hook: football-community comedy widens the father-son reconciliation story, but the evidence does not yet show that familiarity converts into paid demand.
coming.promo: Active, locally rooted rollout: the campaign staged a Lombok gala with tarkam figures and distributed frequent football-led TikTok creatives immediately before release.
coming.social: Reach without strong intent: ten recent TikTok samples accumulated 71,535 views, but only 464 likes, three comments and six shares, making response visibly shallow.
coming.demand: Ticket demand unproven: Cinema XXI confirms a September 3 release page, but the readable captures contain no title-level sales, seat occupancy, sell-outs or verified booking velocity.
coming.risk: Main risk is false confidence: an energetic campaign surrounds a first independent Entelekey Sinema Indonesia production, while quality and purchase intent remain unverified.
coming.bet: The father-son and tarkam-football hook will reach the comparable local-release median in admits per show by Day 4.
coming.nug: A distinctly Indonesian tarkam-football spectacle makes the family reconciliation premise accessible; whether familiarity sells tickets remains unproven.

coming.meta: Masayu Anastasia, Karya Kreatif Utama: Ge Pamungkas, Teuku Rifnu Wikana and Samuel Rizal support the ensemble; Ozan Ruz directs.
coming.logline: Pathologist Hastry reads the evidence left by victims while unexplained intuitions draw her toward truths that conventional investigation misses.
coming.quality: Promising curiosity, unproven quality: advance-screening posts describe an involving mystery and interest in following the case, but no captured independent review establishes execution or audience satisfaction.
coming.gold: Differentiated adult mystery: the real-life forensic foundation and science-versus-intuition tension offer a clearer hook than generic horror, but the subject may remain niche without strong word of mouth.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign, limited proven scale: an official Cinema XXI trailer exists and late-August screening, reaction and testimonial posts were captured, but no broad campaign reach total is available.
coming.social: Small but live social pulse: relevant captured TikToks reached roughly 254 to 6,946 views, with the strongest post recording 101 likes and 32 shares; scale and purchase intent remain unproven.
coming.demand: Release proximity without conversion proof: the film is listed for September 3 and has fresh social activity, but no captured presales, seat maps, sold-out shows, booking counts or explicit ticket intent exist.
coming.risk: Positioning and conversion risk: the science-led forensic promise is diluted by unexplained intuition and supernatural elements, while absent purchase evidence leaves the title vulnerable to weak opening conversion.
coming.bet: The forensic true-story hook will convert initial awareness into stronger admissions than comparable local newcomers by Day 4.
coming.nug: A forensic mystery inspired by Indonesian practice offers a more distinctive adult hook than conventional haunted-house horror.

lanes.read: Forensic mystery with a supernatural edge: pathologist Hastry reads the evidence left by victims while unexplained intuitions pull her toward truths that conventional investigation misses.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured MOPIC synopsis directly describes Hastry balancing forensic science with intuitions that cannot always be explained by logic.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room can position the title around an unusual forensic-investigation hook, without presenting it as either pure horror or a strictly scientific procedural.

lanes.decision_consequence: The cast supplies familiarity for a discovery-floor launch, but the bundle does not establish any performer as a proven opening-weekend ticket driver.

lanes.read: Promising curiosity, unproven quality: advance-screening posts describe an involving mystery and interest in following the case, but no captured independent review establishes execution or audience satisfaction.

lanes.read: Differentiated adult mystery: the real-life forensic foundation and science-versus-intuition tension offer a clearer hook than generic horror, but the subject may remain niche without strong word of mouth.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured sources consistently position the film around Indonesian forensic practice inspired by Sumy Hastry Purwanti rather than a conventional haunted-house premise.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title visible at the Day-0 discovery floor and sell the forensic case-solving distinction; reserve expansion for demonstrated local conversion.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign, limited proven scale: an official Cinema XXI trailer exists and late-August screening, reaction and testimonial posts were captured, but no broad campaign reach total is available.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The bundle captured an official Cinema XXI-hosted trailer plus multiple recent TikTok posts tied to screenings, reactions and the September 3 release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Campaign support reduces discovery risk enough to justify baseline visibility, but its unmeasured reach does not justify extra sessions by itself.

lanes.read: Small but live social pulse: relevant captured TikToks reached roughly 254 to 6,946 views, with the strongest post recording 101 likes and 32 shares; scale and purchase intent remain unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The highest-view relevant captured post had 6,946 views, 101 likes, 6 comments and 32 shares, while other film-related samples were mostly below 5,000 views.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat circulation as awareness, not demand; verify against film-specific paid behavior.

lanes.read: Release proximity without conversion proof: the film is listed for September 3 and has fresh social activity, but no captured presales, seat maps, sold-out shows, booking counts or explicit ticket intent exist.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: MOPIC confirms the September 3 release listing; the social sample shows awareness and screening discussion but contains no measurable purchase conversion.
lanes.missing_fact: Chain-level showtimes or presales, seat movement, explicit ticket-buying intent, or another direct purchase-proximity measure.
lanes.decision_consequence: Apply the Day-0 discovery floor rather than suppressing the title, but do not allocate above that floor until local admissions or ticketing evidence appears.

lanes.read: Positioning and conversion risk: the science-led forensic promise is diluted by unexplained intuition and supernatural elements, while absent purchase evidence leaves the title vulnerable to weak opening conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: VIVA emphasizes professional, ethical, science-based autopsy practice, whereas the direct MOPIC synopsis introduces intuitions that cannot be explained by logic.
lanes.decision_consequence: Test whether the forensic mystery is clear enough to convert beyond curiosity.

title_hypotheses.title: MUNAFIK: MELAWAN IBLIS
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: The recognizable cast, religious-horror premise and active campaign will place the title in the top half of new releases by paid admissions per show on Day 1, while maintaining at least 70% of normalized occupancy by Day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Recognizable leads, the established Munafik concept and sustained launch activity support a measurable opening test, while shallow social discussion and absent transaction data make retention the necessary check.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis fails if the title ranks in the bottom half on Day 1 or retains less than 70% of normalized Day-1 occupancy by Day 4.

measurement.comparison: Rank Day-1 paid admissions per show against comparable new releases, then test whether normalized Day-4 occupancy retains at least 70% of Day 1.

title_hypotheses.title: BABY UDON

title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis fails if Day-1 occupancy is weak despite BOGOF, or if Day-4 paid occupancy falls below the comparable local-drama hold needed to justify maintaining or expanding sessions.

measurement.comparison: Compare Day-1 and Day-4 paid occupancy with equivalent local-drama sessions, separating BOGOF redemptions from ordinary paid tickets.

title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis fails if the title remains below the comparable local-release median across sites through Day 4 without a strengthening prime-time or weekend pattern.

measurement.comparison: Compare each site with its comparable local-new-release median, separating prime and off-peak sessions; assess Day-4 weekend productivity against Day 1.

title_hypotheses.title: AUTOPSY DEAD BODY CAN TALK

title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified upward if the title materially clears the discovery floor and sustains relative strength through Day 4; it is falsified downward if even baseline sessions fail the floor without recovery.

measurement.comparison: Compare Day-1 and Day-4 admissions per show with the cycle's other local newcomers, separating prime-time from off-peak results.
